sources.entry: Adminer - Database management in a single PHP file. Available for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MS SQL, Oracle, Elasticsearch, MongoDB and others. (Source Code) Apache-2.0/GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Adminer is a full-featured database management tool written in PHP that deploys as a single file.
summary.what_it_does: Adminer is a web-based database management tool written in PHP, distributed as one file that can be copied to a target server. The README lists support for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, SQLite, MS SQL and Oracle. Plugins are listed for Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, SimpleDB, MongoDB, Redis, Firebird, ClickHouse, IGDB and IMAP. A separate Adminer Editor offers data manipulation for end-users, and the repo includes a compile.php script to build the single-file version. The README also mentions Playwright end-to-end tests and a lang.php script for translations.
use_cases: browse and edit tables in a MySQL or MariaDB database
manage PostgreSQL databases through a web browser
administer SQLite database files on a server
give end-users a simple data editing interface
query MongoDB or Elasticsearch data through a PHP web tool
how_to_run: git submodule update --init (if downloaded from Git)
Build a single-file version with compile.php
Deploy the resulting single PHP file to the web server
notable: Entire tool ships as a single PHP file for easy deployment
Adminer Editor variant offers simplified data manipulation for end-users
Broad database support including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MS SQL, Oracle and CockroachDB
Plugin system with many database and data-store plugins, plus user-contributed plugins listed on the Adminer Plugins page
caveats: Source code requires PHP 7.4+; compiled file requires PHP 5.4+
Many non-SQL integrations (Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Redis, etc.) are provided as plugins rather than core features
